list_child.name: list_logbook_runs
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete set of experiment runs currently held in the lab's electronic run logbook. This includes every run the lab has started, whatever phase it has reached.

decoys.name: list_instrument_runs
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of experiment runs currently held in the lab's instrument booking calendar. This includes every run that has reserved time on the shared equipment.

decoys.name: list_biobank_runs
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of experiment runs currently held in the lab's biobank index. This includes every run whose specimens are stored in the lab's freezers.

decoys.name: list_billing_runs
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of experiment runs currently held in the core facility billing ledger. This includes every run that has been charged to a grant account.

get_child.name: get_run_logbook
get_child.desc: Look up the logbook page of a single experiment run using its unique identifier. This is the primary way to inspect one run's protocol, phase, and recorded settings.

decoys.name: get_run_data
decoys.desc: Look up the raw data files of a single experiment run using its unique identifier. This is the primary way to inspect one run's instrument output and measurements.

decoys.name: get_run_custody
decoys.desc: Look up the custody record of a single experiment run using its unique identifier. This is the primary way to inspect one run's specimen handling history.

decoys.name: get_run_approval
decoys.desc: Look up the safety approval of a single experiment run using its unique identifier. This is the primary way to inspect one run's biosafety and ethics sign-offs.

list_parent.name: list_funding_sponsors
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the complete list of sponsoring organizations held in the lab's funding register. Every sponsor with active or past grants appears in this listing.

decoys.name: list_transfer_sponsors
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of sponsoring organizations held in the lab's material transfer file. Every sponsor that has exchanged samples or reagents appears in this listing.

decoys.name: list_board_sponsors
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of sponsoring organizations held in the lab's advisory board roster. Every sponsor represented at the annual review appears in this listing.

decoys.name: list_licensing_sponsors
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of sponsoring organizations held in the lab's technology licensing register. Every sponsor that licenses the lab's methods appears in this listing.

get_parent.name: get_sponsor_record
get_parent.desc: Look up the register record for a single sponsoring organization using its unique identifier. Returns the sponsor details the lab keeps on file.

decoys.name: get_sponsor_grants
decoys.desc: Look up the grant awards for a single sponsoring organization using its unique identifier. Returns the award amounts and periods the lab keeps on file.

decoys.name: get_sponsor_terms
decoys.desc: Look up the reporting terms for a single sponsoring organization using its unique identifier. Returns the deliverables and deadlines the lab keeps on file.

decoys.name: get_sponsor_contacts
decoys.desc: Look up the program officers for a single sponsoring organization using its unique identifier. Returns the names and roles the lab keeps on file.

delete_child.name: erase_run_logbook
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase an experiment run from the lab's logbook, an action that is final once it completes. Use this for runs logged in error or superseded by a corrected run.

decoys.name: discard_run_samples
decoys.desc: Permanently discard the stored specimens of an experiment run from the lab's freezers, an action that is final once it completes. Use this for samples past their retention date or spoiled by a freezer failure.

decoys.name: delete_run_data
decoys.desc: Permanently delete the raw data records of an experiment run from the lab's storage, an action that is final once it completes. Use this for data captured in error or superseded by a corrected acquisition.

decoys.name: retract_run_results
decoys.desc: Permanently retract the reported results of an experiment run from the lab's reports, an action that is final once it completes. Use this for findings withdrawn after an error turns up in the analysis.

set_enum.name: set_run_phase
set_enum.desc: Update the phase of an experiment run to reflect whether it is running, completed, or aborted. Keeping this current is essential for the lab's own run records.

decoys.name: set_planned_phase
decoys.desc: Update the planned phase of an experiment run to reflect whether it should be running, completed, or aborted by the next milestone. Keeping this current is essential for the lab's scheduling board.

decoys.name: set_reported_phase
decoys.desc: Update the phase reported to the sponsor for an experiment run, choosing whether it appears as running, completed, or aborted. Keeping this current is essential for the quarterly progress letters.

decoys.name: request_run_phase
decoys.desc: Request a new phase for an experiment run, proposing whether it should be running, completed, or aborted for the principal investigator to approve. Keeping this current is essential for the sign-off trail.

set_bool.name: flag_needs_review
set_bool.desc: Mark an experiment run as awaiting peer review so reviewers know to look it over before results are shared externally. This flag drives the lab's weekly review queue.

decoys.name: flag_needs_audit
decoys.desc: Mark an experiment run as awaiting a data integrity audit so auditors know to check it before results are shared externally. This flag drives the lab's quality assurance queue.

decoys.name: flag_needs_rerun
decoys.desc: Mark an experiment run as awaiting a repeat so technicians know to schedule it again before results are shared externally. This flag drives the lab's bench planning queue.

decoys.name: flag_needs_ethics
decoys.desc: Mark an experiment run as awaiting ethics committee sign-off so the committee knows to review it before work continues. This flag drives the lab's compliance queue.

set_ref.name: move_run_funding
set_ref.desc: Move an experiment run's funding attribution to a different sponsor, which is useful when a run was logged against an incorrect grant. This change propagates to all sponsor-facing reports.

decoys.name: move_run_custody
decoys.desc: Move an experiment run's stored specimens to a different sponsor, which is useful when a partner lab will continue the analysis. This transfer is recorded in the lab's material transfer file.

decoys.name: move_run_access
decoys.desc: Move an experiment run's data access to a different sponsor, which is useful when a new funder takes over the collaboration. This access is recorded in the lab's data sharing register.
verbs: move the raw data access of {obj} {to_name}

decoys.name: move_run_license
decoys.desc: Move an experiment run's method license to a different sponsor, which is useful when an industry partner takes over commercial rights. This agreement is recorded in the lab's technology licensing register.

send.name: notify_sponsor
send.desc: Send a notification to a sponsoring organization regarding an experiment run or its overall funding standing. This is the lab's primary channel for sponsor-facing updates.

decoys.name: invoice_sponsor
decoys.desc: Send an invoice to a sponsoring organization regarding an experiment run or its overall cost to date. This is the lab's standard channel for sponsor billing.

decoys.name: incident_sponsor
decoys.desc: Send an incident report to a sponsoring organization regarding an experiment run or its safety record. This is the lab's required channel for adverse event disclosure.
child_verbs: file an incident report with the sponsor behind {obj}
report the incident on {obj} to its sponsor

decoys.name: invite_sponsor
decoys.desc: Send a site visit invitation to a sponsoring organization regarding an experiment run or its facilities. This is the lab's usual channel for arranging sponsor visits.
child_verbs: invite the sponsor behind {obj} for a site visit
send the sponsor of {obj} a visit invitation

create.name: create_run
create.desc: Create a new experiment run for a sponsor, with an optional protocol name and starting phase. This is how the lab opens a fresh entry in the run logbook.

decoys.name: create_booking
decoys.desc: Create a new instrument booking for a sponsor, with an optional protocol name and starting phase. This is how the lab reserves time on shared equipment.

decoys.name: create_proposal
decoys.desc: Create a new grant proposal for a sponsor, with an optional protocol name and starting phase. This is how the lab starts a fresh funding application.

decoys.name: create_order
decoys.desc: Create a new reagent order for a sponsor, with an optional protocol name and starting phase. This is how the lab requests supplies charged to a grant.

list_notes.name: list_run_observations
list_notes.desc: Retrieve the observations attached to one experiment run. This includes every observation researchers have logged against that run.

decoys.name: list_run_deviations
decoys.desc: Retrieve the protocol deviations attached to one experiment run. This includes every departure from procedure researchers have logged against that run.

decoys.name: list_observation_followups
decoys.desc: Retrieve the observation follow-ups attached to one experiment run. This includes every answer researchers have logged against its observations.

decoys.name: list_run_incidents
decoys.desc: Retrieve the safety incidents attached to one experiment run. This includes every spill or exposure staff have logged against that run.

add_note.name: add_run_observation
add_note.desc: Attach a new observation to an experiment run, with an optional title. This records an observation made at the bench.

decoys.name: add_run_deviation
decoys.desc: Attach a new protocol deviation to an experiment run, with an optional title. This records a departure from the approved procedure.

decoys.name: suggest_run_observation
decoys.desc: Suggest a new observation on an experiment run, with an optional title. This proposes an observation for the investigator to accept.

decoys.name: add_run_incident
decoys.desc: Attach a new safety incident to an experiment run, with an optional title. This records a spill or exposure at the bench.

update_note.name: update_run_observation
update_note.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing observation on an experiment run. This corrects or expands an observation after it was logged.

decoys.name: update_run_deviation
decoys.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing protocol deviation on an experiment run. This corrects or expands a deviation after it was logged.

decoys.name: comment_run_observation
decoys.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of a comment on an existing observation on an experiment run. This answers an observation after it was logged.

decoys.name: update_run_incident
decoys.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing safety incident on an experiment run. This corrects or expands an incident after it was logged.

delete_note.name: remove_run_observation
delete_note.desc: Permanently remove an observation from an experiment run. The observation is erased from the lab's logs for good.

decoys.name: remove_run_deviation
decoys.desc: Permanently remove a protocol deviation from an experiment run. The deviation is erased from the lab's logs for good.

decoys.name: strike_run_observation
decoys.desc: Permanently strike through an observation on an experiment run. The text is crossed out in the lab's logs for good.

decoys.name: remove_run_incident
decoys.desc: Permanently remove a safety incident from an experiment run. The incident is erased from the lab's logs for good.

set_image.name: set_run_overview
set_image.desc: Set the overview image shown on an experiment run record. This is usually a photo of the bench setup taken at the start of the run.

decoys.name: set_run_gel
decoys.desc: Set the gel image shown on an experiment run record. This is usually the stained gel scan taken after electrophoresis.

decoys.name: set_run_micrograph
decoys.desc: Set the micrograph image shown on an experiment run record. This is usually the microscope capture taken at the end of the run.

decoys.name: set_run_platemap
decoys.desc: Set the plate map image shown on an experiment run record. This is usually the well layout drawn before samples are loaded.

writer.name: write_memo
writer.desc: Write a memo from a brief, which states the gist in the requester's own words, and the experiment runs it should mention. Returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_abstract
decoys.desc: Write a conference abstract from a brief, which states the findings in the requester's own words, and the experiment runs it should mention. Returns the finished abstract.

decoys.name: write_methods
decoys.desc: Write a methods section from a brief, which states the approach in the requester's own words, and the experiment runs it should mention. Returns the finished section.

decoys.name: write_progress
decoys.desc: Write a short progress report from a brief, which states the milestones in the requester's own words, and the experiment runs it should mention. Returns the finished report.

image.name: generate_illustrative_image
image.desc: Generate an illustrative image from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the result.

decoys.name: generate_poster_image
decoys.desc: Generate a poster image from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the layout.

decoys.name: generate_figure_image
decoys.desc: Generate a figure image from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the panel.

decoys.name: generate_schematic_image
decoys.desc: Generate a schematic image from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the drawing.

search.name: search_handbook
search.desc: Search the lab system handbook with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to look up how the lab's software works.

decoys.name: search_sops
decoys.desc: Search the lab's standard operating procedures with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to look up an approved bench method.

decoys.name: search_sds
decoys.desc: Search the chemical safety data sheets with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to look up handling rules for a reagent.

decoys.name: search_vendor
decoys.desc: Search the instrument vendor manuals with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to look up how a machine is operated.
